title: The Final Outlaw
short: Ride a trail of 100 desert challenges, then face an endless frontier.
strap: One trail. A hundred last stands.
cards: Fight through 100 saved town layouts, with adobe houses, roads, alleys and cover across ten districts.
Move with your left thumb, hold the gun control to fire, and manage a 20-round starting magazine with a clear reload.
Gear for the next last stand
Improve seven gear tracks and face runners, armored tanks, ranged monsters and guardians in campaign or endless survival.
artwork: 28 distinct original illustrated assets; originals and prompts in source_art/round-two/
